Rebase of #1348 onto origin/main had 6 keep-both conflicts, resolved; build, usage tests, hook gates, lint, format, dark-code all pass. Rebase changed the patch-id so old leaves no longer bind. next-step spawned only code-reviewer-codex and security-reviewer; Codex hit its usage limit, so a Claude-native code-reviewer ran as fallback and security approved. verify-attestation then rejects: missing test-reviewer for a full-diff trust-chain-path set. Remote branch currently holds the rebased head 18c2197f with its old, stale envelopes removed locally only; 3 local chore commits (drop stale envelopes, two auto-sign) are unpushed and the signed envelope is invalid. Next step: a normal full review round on the current head, then sign and lease-push.
